title: Classification: follow the issued licence
label: Application + MD-5 reviewed
finding: Class B is documented in the issued MD-5. The earlier Class A application is retained as part of the regulatory history.
boundary: The separate issued CAL copy is not in the reviewed set; its date and reference are attributed to company publications.

title: Licence and registration copies: read their stated scope
label: Originals reviewed
finding: Original licence and registration copies are reviewed by named entity, activity, reference and printed dates.
boundary: Current suspension, cancellation, renewal or amendment status requires a dated issuer check. Only exact live registry matches receive the registry badge.

title: GST: preserve the historical record
label: Historical original reviewed
finding: The 2017 REG-06 is retained with its printed legal and trade names, alongside the company name-change history.
boundary: The reviewed certificate does not establish the current amended legal name or taxpayer status.

title: External validation: identify the source as a protocol
label: Original protocol reviewed
finding: The reviewed external-validation source is a published study protocol. It sets out planned methods; completed results are not claimed.
boundary: A final study report, with its population, methods, results and limitations, would support a new evidence conclusion.

title: Outcome claims: keep the calculation boundary visible
label: Source publications reviewed
finding: The headline improvement claim is recorded as company-reported. No verified network-wide percentage is concluded from this document set.
boundary: The SAE 3000 scope excludes outcome-study figures. A defined denominator and reproducible calculation are required to evaluate the headline claim.

title: Centre evidence: match each document to its premises
label: Source review recorded
finding: All 52 workbook centres are included. Across the workbook and inspected certificate copies, 53 distinct HFR identifiers are retained. Eight district summaries and four individually inspected district originals remain separate.
boundary: Workbook RS flags do not establish operational or HFR status. Nellore’s district certificate period ended on 30 October 2024. The additional Tirupati certificate is retained without assuming replacement or cancellation.

title: Practitioner reports: preserve the stated scope
label: Originals reviewed · live UDINs matched
finding: Both exact UDINs showed Active in the ICAI portal on 19 September 2026, with practitioner and signing particulars matched. Restricted full reports are not republished here.
boundary: The reports’ circulation restrictions remain attached. A UDIN match authenticates particulars and does not enlarge a report’s assurance scope.
